# Wheel truing log

The front wheel had a wobble bad enough to feel through the fork at speed, so it went up on the
truing stand before anything else got reassembled.

## Front wheel

Found two loose spokes on the drive side and one that had actually lost most of its tension. Brought
everything back to even tension with a spoke wrench, working in quarter-turns and checking the dish
after every pass rather than chasing the wobble directly — chasing it directly is how you end up with
a wheel that's true but badly out of dish.

## Rear wheel

Rear was in much better shape — just a light lateral wobble, sorted in about fifteen minutes. Tension
was already close to even, so this was mostly fine-tuning rather than a rebuild.

## Lesson

Zbigniew from the shop down the street walked me through reading the dish gauge properly, which was
the piece I'd been getting wrong — I'd been eyeballing it against the frame instead of using the tool,
and that's exactly what let the front wheel drift out of true in the first place.
